hero.step1Desc: Use your voice in Punjabi, Hindi, or tap quick symptom cards. Tell us age, duration, and severity.
hero.step2Desc: Our dual-engine safety check instantly identifies emergencies and provides clear, color-coded urgency levels.
hero.step3Desc: Get simple home-care advice, dangerous warning signs, audio readout, and the nearest Punjab hospital with direct call links.
hero.safetyBody: Organigen Health does not prescribe medicines or drug dosages. We help rural families make safe decisions about when and where to seek medical attention.

about.title: About Organigen Health
about.subtitle: Rural Health Triage Protocol & Safety Guidelines
about.missionText: Organigen Health is designed for families and frontline ASHA workers across rural Punjab. It bridges the critical first-hour gap between symptom onset and professional medical care by determining clinical urgency.
about.ruleEngineText: Before contacting any AI, our deterministic clinical engine checks for life-threatening danger signs including chest pain, stroke (FAST criteria), acute respiratory distress, severe hemorrhage, and infant lethargy.
about.aiEngineText: For non-emergency cases, the Google Gemini model delivers 6th-grade level guidance, personalized home-care steps, and danger warnings in Punjabi, Hindi, or English.
about.dial102: 102 - Free Referral Transport for Pregnant Women & Infants
about.disclaimerFull: Organigen Health provides preliminary triage guidance for informative and educational purposes only. It is not an electronic medical record, does not perform clinical diagnosis, and never prescribes pharmaceuticals or drug dosages. Always seek the advice of a qualified physician, civil hospital doctor, or Primary Health Centre medical officer.
